title: Forever
author: Judy Blume
current_text: In 1997, a parent’s complaint led a school board to vote to remove Forever from the one area middle school that carried it in Elgin, Illinois. In 1999, a school librarian asked the school board to reconsider its 1997 decision on Forever, but the book remained off the shelf after a 3-3 vote on lifting the ban. On January 22, 2002, the School District U-46 Board voted 5-2 to reinstate Forever. By 1982, schools in Pennsylvania, Florida, and Ohio had challenged Forever for not promoting abstinence or monogamy.

sources.quote: In 1997, the book was removed from the one area middle school that carried it at the time because of a parent’s initial complaint and the school board’s resulting vote to remove it.

sources.quote: By 1982, schools in Pennsylvania, Florida, and Ohio had challenged the book for not promoting abstinence or monogamy. One school district complained that it was “basically a sexual how-to-do book for junior-high students,” while another claimed it “demoralizes marital sex.”
